title: Carrier Disruption Entitlements on Air Ticket Fare Brands
content:
A carrier's own record of a schedule move confers the entitlement that attaches to a booking sold under Air Ticket Fare Brands. The fare brand held fixes the size of move from which that entitlement arises, the fee charged for a rebooking where the move is smaller, and the overnight allowance reimbursed after a qualifying disruption.

Terms:

1. The figure shown for the fare brand held is the size of airline schedule move, in minutes, from which a free change or refund right arises under that brand.
2. The rebooking fee shown for the fare brand held is the fee charged to rebook after an airline disruption where the move is below that size.
3. An overnight hotel allowance is reimbursed in the amount shown for each traveller for each night after a qualifying disruption.

| Fare brand | Schedule move conferring a free change or refund | Rebooking fee where the move is smaller | Overnight hotel allowance, each traveller each night |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Basic Economy Lite | 180 minutes | 125.00 dollars | 0.00 dollars |
| Economy Saver | 180 minutes | 99.00 dollars | 0.00 dollars |
| Economy Classic | 120 minutes | 75.00 dollars | 125.00 dollars |
| Economy Flex | 120 minutes | 50.00 dollars | 150.00 dollars |
| Premium Economy Select | 90 minutes | 50.00 dollars | 175.00 dollars |
| Business Saver | 60 minutes | 0.00 dollars | 225.00 dollars |
| Business Flex | 60 minutes | 0.00 dollars | 275.00 dollars |

Annotations to these terms:

On a hypothetical Economy Classic booking, a recorded move of 150 minutes is larger than 120 minutes and confers a free change or a refund; a recorded move of 90 minutes is smaller than 120 minutes and is rebooked against a fee of 75.00 dollars. A recorded move of exactly 120 minutes is at the size from which the right arises in that brand, the figure being the size from which it arises and not the size above it.

Business Saver and Business Flex carry a rebooking fee of 0.00 dollars, so a move recorded below 60 minutes is rebooked at no charge to the traveller. Basic Economy Lite and Economy Saver carry an overnight hotel allowance of 0.00 dollars, and no overnight amount is reimbursed on them; on a hypothetical Business Flex disruption of two nights, 275.00 dollars is reimbursed for the first night and 275.00 dollars for the second.
